title: Tactile exit signs.
officialText: A tactile sign stating EXIT and complying with ICC A117.1 shall be provided adjacent to each door to an area of rescue assistance, an exterior area for assisted rescue, and exit stairway, an exit ramp, an exit passageway, a horizontal exit and the exit discharge.
